## Lua

## Introduction

Stormworks offers a special logic component, the "Script". It allows you to program Lua code that can interact with composite data and draw onto video signals.

If you want to use Lua in Stormworks [read the Lua Guide](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Guides/Lua)
